youtube.title: Why Is Coca-Cola Red? (It's Not Santa) #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Coca-Cola is brown. So why is everything about it red? Most people say Santa Claus. The red came decades earlier, and the real reason is a tax rule.

From a bookkeeper's red letters in 1886 Atlanta to red-painted syrup barrels in the 1890s, and a red-suited Santa selling mineral water in 1915, sixteen years before Coca-Cola's famous ads, this is how one color became one of the most recognised on Earth.

instagram.caption:
Coca-Cola didn't make Santa red. 🎅🥤

The red came first: red letters in 1886, red barrels in the 1890s so tax agents could tell soda from whiskey. A red Santa was selling mineral water in 1915, 16 years before Coke's ads.
